calibration.caveat: cuBLAS separate graphs show up to ~1% persistent A/A bias; exploratory CI can exclude 1; no unbiased estimator or general statistical guarantee claimed

screening.correctness: all 8 development workloads, frozen seeds, boundary/immutability/output/stream checks must pass before and after timing
screening.speedup: current incumbent latency / candidate latency; compare to original initial template separately at final freeze
screening.capture_order: alternate incumbent-first/candidate-first between independent sessions; record physical capture order
screening.cache_policies: repeated and 16-input ring must both pass; never merge policies to hide regression
screening.aggregation: for each session, average log pair speedups per anchor, then equally average the three anchor logs; take mean of the session logs
screening.uncertainty: with 3 sessions use exp(mean +/- 4.303 * sample_stdev(session_logs) / sqrt(3)); exploratory screening interval, no multiple-search confidence guarantee
screening.guard_measurement: all 8 development workloads; unsupported, error, timeout or nonfinite timing cannot promote
screening.new_candidate_timing_range: if outside calibrated per-call range or mode, run a same-candidate A/A before decision; instability means no promotion
screening.failure: retain current incumbent; runtime fallback is trusted cuBLAS; no source replacement on error or insufficient gain

final_acceptance: freeze source then run evaluator-held 4 workloads once; independent final sessions against original initial template >=3, all failures retained
status: frozen before model search; no implementation promoted

timing_clarification.change: only timing scope and links clarified after calibration; numerical/layout/output/support/reference/seeds unchanged
